column2: it will cease to exist after being exiled
column3: Contradicts the card's Oracle text in part (template error; policy ruling-contradicting-oracle-gives-way, decided by the user Nov 5; this ruling decided by the user Nov 20): Seraph's 2007-09-16 ruling says a token "will cease to exist after being exiled", but Seraph exiles nothing ("Whenever a creature dealt damage by this creature this turn dies, put that card onto the battlefield under your control at the beginning of the next end step. ..."): the token dies and ceases to exist in the graveyard (CR 704.5d). Likely origin: Tawnos's Coffin's ruling of the same day ("If the targeted creature is a token, it will cease to exist after being exiled. ...", 2007-09-16), right for the Coffin, which exiles the creature. What the ruling says of the token ("It won't be returned to the battlefield.") agrees with the card and stays cited (tests/rulings/r_residue_misc_2b_triggers.rs); logged in docs/RULING_DISCREPANCIES.md
